name_zh: 反对派/瓜伊多/民主斗争：后民粹民主修复与过渡正义
name_en: Opposition/Guaido/Democratic Struggle: Post-Populist Democratic Repair & Transitional Justice
description_zh: 胡安·瓜伊多 (1983-) 国民议会议长/2019 宣誓临时总统/50+ 国家承认/军事倒戈失败/2023 反对派初选/马查多/2024 大选/马杜罗争议连任。核心斗争逻辑：宪法第 233 条合法性/国际承认联盟/街头动员/制裁施压/军队分化/谈判对话(墨西哥/巴巴多斯/多哈)/选举条件/过渡正义设计。体现 M193 后民粹民主修复 — 以"宪法合法性+国际联盟+街头动员+谈判过渡"四位一体，在民粹巩固/军队控制/制裁疲劳/反对派分裂四重困境中寻求民主回归路径。
description_en: Juan Guaido (1983-) National Assembly President/2019 swore interim president/50+ nations recognized/military defection failed/2023 opposition primary/Machado/2024 election/Maduro disputed reelection. Core struggle logic: Constitution Art. 233 legitimacy/international recognition alliance/street mobilization/sanctions pressure/military fracture/negotiated dialogue (Mexico/Barbados/Doha)/electoral conditions/transitional justice design. Exemplifies M193 Post-Populist Democratic Repair — quaternity of 'constitutional legitimacy + international alliance + street mobilization + negotiated transition' seeking democratic return path amid quadruple bind of populist consolidation/military control/sanctions fatigue/opposition fragmentation.
reason_zh: 瓜伊多非单纯挑战者，而是"宪法条款+国际承认+街头+谈判"四位一体过渡架构师。以第 233 条填补权力真空，以 50 国承认构建外交壁垒，以街头动员维持压力，以谈判设计过渡条件。M193 区隔于 M193 后冲突修复(秘鲁)、M168 石油民粹(查韦斯)、M171 资源民族主义(查韦斯)，核心在于"宪法条款即合法性锚点+国际承认即外交杠杆+谈判即过渡工程"的后民粹民主修复范式。
reason_en: Guaido not mere challenger but 'constitutional article + international recognition + streets + negotiations' quaternity transition architect. Art. 233 filled power vacuum, 50-nation recognition built diplomatic wall, street mobilization maintained pressure, negotiations designed transition conditions. M193 distinct from M193 Post-Conflict Repair (Peru), M168 Oil Populism (Chavez), M171 Resource Nationalist (Chavez), core: 'constitutional article as legitimacy anchor + international recognition as diplomatic leverage + negotiations as transition engineering' post-populist democratic repair paradigm.
steps_zh: 宪法第 233 条合法性锚点：总统空缺/国民议会议长代行/2019 1 月 23 日宣誓/法律/宪法/议会三重合法性
国际承认联盟构建：50+ 国家/欧盟/利马集团/OAS/联合国/资产保护/外交隔离马杜罗/人道援助走廊
街头动员与军队分化：周六大游行/军队呼吁倒戈/集体/公社/情报/反间谍/军队核心忠诚/基层动摇
谈判对话与过渡条件：墨西哥/巴巴多斯/多哈/选举时间表/观察员/政治犯释放/媒体准入/司法独立/过渡政府设计
反对派初选与大选博弈：2023 初选马查多胜出/最高法院取消资格/2024 大选马杜罗争议连任/反对派拒认/国际分歧/民主修复未完成
steps_en: Constitution Art. 233 legitimacy anchor: presidential vacancy/Assembly President acting/Jan 23 2019 oath/legal/constitutional/parliamentary triple legitimacy
International recognition alliance construction: 50+ nations/EU/Lima Group/OAS/UN/asset protection/diplomatic isolation Maduro/humanitarian aid corridor
Street mobilization & military fracture: Saturday mass marches/military defection appeals/collectives/communes/intel/counter-intel/military core loyalty/grassroots wavering
Negotiated dialogue & transition conditions: Mexico/Barbados/Doha/election timeline/observers/political prisoner release/media access/judicial independence/transitional govt design
Opposition primary & election game: 2023 primary Machado wins/Supreme Court disqualifies/2024 election Maduro disputed reelection/opposition rejects/international split/democratic repair incomplete
expected_zh: 以"宪法合法性+国际联盟+街头动员+谈判过渡"四位一体，在民粹巩固/军队控制/制裁疲劳/反对派分裂四重困境中寻求民主回归路径，留下过渡工程未完成/制度重建待续的艰难遗产。
